mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,outbox_id,status,attempt_count,locked_by,correlation_id,lock_version FROM outbox_event WHERE contract_ref=#{establishedContractRef} AND contract_version=#{version} AND aggregate_type='INCIDENT' AND attempt_count<=#{maxAttempts} AND ((status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=#{now}) OR (status='PUBLISHING' AND locked_at<=#{cutoff})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN next_attempt_at ELSE locked_at END, tenant_id,outbox_id LIMIT #{outboxMaxClaims}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1, locked_by=#{token},locked_at=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PENDING' AND attempt_count=#{attemptCount} AND attempt_count<#{maxAttempts} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND next_attempt_at<=#{now3}

UPDATE outbox_event SET attempt_count=attempt_count+1,locked_by=#{token},locked_at=#{now}, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE', updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{attemptCount} AND attempt_count<#{maxAttempts} AND locked_by=#{lockedBy} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND locked_at<=#{cutoff}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHING',locked_by=#{token},locked_at=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PENDING' AND attempt_count=#{maxAttempts} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND next_attempt_at<=#{now3}

UPDATE outbox_event SET locked_by=#{token},locked_at=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{maxAttempts} AND locked_by=#{lockedBy} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND locked_at<=#{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,outbox_id,message_id,publication_key,business_intent_key, aggregate_id,body_bytes,body_sha256,correlation_id,causation_id, attempt_count,locked_by,locked_at,lock_version,created_at FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{attempt} AND locked_by=#{token} AND lock_version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PUBLISHED',locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error_code=NULL, broker_confirmed_at=#{now},lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now2}, updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{attemptCount} AND locked_by=#{token} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND locked_at>#{cutoff}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='RESOLVED',resolved_at=#{now},next_attempt_at=NULL, lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId} AND state='REPLAYING' AND lock_version=#{lockVersion}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='PENDING',next_attempt_at=#{next},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL, last_error_code=#{safeCode},broker_confirmed_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{attemptCount} AND locked_by=#{token} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND locked_at>#{cutoff}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status='RECOVERY_REQUIRED',next_attempt_at=#{now},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL, last_error_code=#{safeCode},broker_confirmed_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1, updated_at=#{now2},updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PUBLISHING' AND attempt_count=#{maxAttempts} AND locked_by=#{token} AND lock_version=#{lockVersion} AND locked_at>#{cutoff}

UPDATE message_recovery SET state='OPEN',last_error_code=#{code},last_error_summary=#{summary},resolved_at=NULL, next_attempt_at=NULL,lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now}, updated_by_type='SERVICE',updated_by_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recovery_id=#{recoveryId} AND state='REPLAYING' AND lock_version=#{lockVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT recovery_id,business_intent_key,state,attempt_count,last_error_code, last_error_summary,lock_version FROM message_recovery WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND direction='OUTBOX' AND source_record_id=#{outboxId} FOR UPDATE
